content.text: Perfect! "CHIRURGIE DENTAIRE" (code 19) is dental surgery. Now let me query the reimbursement data for dental surgery, using the processing month (FLX_ANN_MOI) and the amount charged before reimbursement (PRS_ACT_COG):

input.sql:
SELECT 
  FLX_ANN_MOI as month,
  SUM(PRS_ACT_COG) as total_charged
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS
WHERE PSE_ACT_SNDS = 19
GROUP BY FLX_ANN_MOI
ORDER BY FLX_ANN_MOI

content.text: Perfect! I found the data. The executing provider's activity field is PSE_ACT_SNDS, and dental surgery is code 19 ("CHIRURGIE DENTAIRE"). The PRS_ACT_COG column contains the amount charged.
